jobs.title: Product Manager, Web
jobs.description:
Driven to be the Best

People. Performance. Purpose.

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

Avis Budget Group is looking for a customer-obsessed Product Manager to own and evolve a critical part of our digital customer journey across web and mobile. Reporting into the VP of E-Commerce Product, this role will focus on a specific segment of the funnel—driving measurable improvements in customer experience, conversion, revenue, and retention.

You’ll operate at the intersection of customer needs, business goals, and technology—leading a cross-functional product “pod” to deliver high-quality, high-impact digital experiences at pace

What You'll Do:

Product Ownership & Delivery
- Own a defined area of the digital funnel (e.g., discovery, booking, post-booking, loyalty) across web and app

- Define and prioritize product backlogs aligned to customer needs and business impact

- Lead your cross-functional pod (engineering, design, analytics) to deliver high-quality product experiences quickly and effectively

- Ensure strong execution using agile methodologies and continuous delivery practices

Customer Experience & Optimization
- Continuously optimize existing features and journeys to improve conversion rates, engagement, and retention

- Identify friction points and opportunities through customer insights, data analysis, and experimentation

- Champion a customer-first mindset in all product decisions

Innovation & Experimentation
- Develop and launch new features, propositions, and experiences that enhance the customer journey

- Run structured experiments (A/B testing, MVPs) to validate ideas and scale what works

- Bring creativity and innovative thinking to solve customer and business problems

Data & Insights
- Use quantitative data and qualitative research to inform product decisions

- Define success metrics and track performance against KPIs

- Partner with analytics and research teams to generate actionable insights

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
- Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and commercial teams to align on priorities and deliver outcomes

- Communicate product vision, progress, and results clearly to stakeholders

- Build strong, collaborative relationships across the organization

Perks You’ll Get:
- Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance

- Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages

- 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions

- Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills

- Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars

- Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

What We're Looking For:
- Proven experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a high-performing e-commerce or digital-first company

- Demonstrated success improving customer metrics such as conversion, revenue, and retention

- Strong understanding of product management and agile methodologies

- Experience leading cross-functional product teams (“pods”) to deliver at pace

- Highly customer-focused, with a strong instinct for identifying and solving user problems

- Analytical mindset with comfort using data and research to drive decisions

- Creative and innovative thinker with a bias toward action

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred (Nice to Have)
- Experience managing both B2C and B2B digital experiences , particularly at scale

- Exposure to complex, multi-channel digital ecosystems

The annual starting salary for this position is between $150,000 – $175,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Who We Are:

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

Avis Budget Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other category protected by applicable law.

This advertisement does not constitute a promise or guarantee of employment. This advertisement describes the general nature and level of this position only. Essential functions and responsibilities may change as business needs require. The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. This position may be with any affiliate of Avis Budget Group.

jobs.description:
Driven to be the Best

People. Performance. Purpose.

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

The Director, Product Management – Innovation leads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of new digital products and capabilities that advance ABG’s mobility platform across the Avis, Budget, and Zipcar brands. This role owns end-to-end product management for high-impact innovation initiatives — from early concept and business case through launch and scale — spanning areas such as the reservation experience, and Online Check-In capabilities, Ready-Line and counter operations technology, and emerging mobility services. The Director partners closely with Technology, Operations, Marketing, and station leadership across NAM, EMEA, and APAC to translate customer and business needs into products that improve Utilization, Revenue, and NPS, while building and mentoring a team of product managers.

What You'll Do:
- Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for assigned innovation product lines, aligned to ABG’s enterprise growth and customer experience priorities.
- Lead cross-functional teams of product managers, engineers, designers, and analysts through discovery, prioritization, and delivery using agile methods.
- Identify and evaluate emerging mobility, travel-tech, and rental-industry trends; build business cases and pilot new concepts to keep ABG’s brands ahead of the competition.
- Partner with Technology leadership on the roadmap for core systems to ensure new features are scalable, secure, and station-ready.
- Collaborate with Marketing and brand teams to ensure products reflect the distinct positioning and voice of Avis, Budget, and Zipcar.
- Work with Revenue Management, Fleet, and Station Operations to size opportunities and translate them into measurable improvements in Utilization, RPD/RPU, and NPS.
- Establish product requirements, success metrics, and go-to-market plans; present roadmap and results to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
- Manage the product P&L view for owned initiatives, including budget input, prioritization trade-offs, and post-launch performance tracking.
- Ensure all products and data practices comply with ABG’s security, privacy, and data classification standards.
- Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers; foster a culture of customer-led innovation and ownership.

- Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars

What We're Looking For:
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
- 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading product managers or a product team.
- Proven track record launching digital products at scale, ideally within travel, mobility, e-commerce, or another high-transaction-volume consumer industry.
- Experience with payment systems a plus
- Experience partnering with global or multi-region stakeholders (NA, EMEA, APAC); franchise/licensee model experience a plus.
- Strong command of agile product delivery, road-mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
- Analytical rigor with the ability to build business cases and translate data into decisions; comfort with revenue and operational metrics such as Utilization and RPD/RPU.

jobs.description:

People. Performance. Purpose.

Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

Our Contact Center AI & Self-Service team is redefining how customers get help from our brands. We are focused on using conversational AI, intelligent knowledge tools, and automation to improve customer experience, reduce friction, and reduce demand on live agents overall. To expedite these plans, we're looking for a Product Manager to help drive our self-service and AI product roadmap forward, reporting to the Director, AI and Innovation for Contact Center.

- Partner closely with engineering, data science, content/knowledge teams, and contact center operations teams to plan, build, and launch new capabilities

- Use conversation analytics and other data sources to identify friction points, containment opportunities, and areas for AI model or content improvement

- Manage the Knowledge Base roadmap, including governance processes and retrieval quality, to ensure agents and AI systems have accurate, up-to-date information

- Evaluate and help prioritize AI-channel revenue opportunities, such as upsell/cross-sell via chat, voice, and other self-service channels

- Work with the Director & Vice President of CX to measure clear KPIs and OKRs in partnership with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to measure success and track progress

- Report on roadmap progress, key metrics (e.g., containment rate, deflection, CSAT, revenue impact), and outcomes to leadership

- Experience defining and tracking KPIs such as containment/deflection rate, CSAT, and revenue per interaction

- Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, operations, and content/knowledge teams

- Analytical mindset with experience using conversation analytics or similar data to inform product decisions

- A bias toward action: able to move from ambiguous problems to a clear roadmap with minimal guidance

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leadership

- Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and their application to self-service and demand reduction

jobs.description:
Driven to be the Best

People. Performance. Purpose.

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

The Director, Product Management – Customer Experience (CX) & Contact Center Technology (Global) will lead the strategy, execution, and delivery of technology products that power the global contact center ecosystem, while enabling broader end-to-end customer experience (CX) transformation.

Reporting to the CX Leader, this role is accountable for global contact center technologies and capabilities, ensuring they deliver seamless, efficient, and intelligent customer and agent experiences. This leader will work in close partnership with other product and technology leaders to deliver an integrated CX product ecosystem.

The role will establish and lead a modern, agile product operating model, organizing work into cross-functional product pods responsible for delivering high-impact customer and operational outcomes. The Director will lead and orchestrate the work of cross-functional resources—including product management, service design, engineering, QA, architecture, analytics, and project management—to drive speed, quality, and measurable business value.

What You'll Do:

Global Contact Center Product Strategy (Aligned to CX)
- Define and execute the global product strategy and roadmap for contact center technologies, aligned with CX and business priorities.
- Ensure scalability, consistency, and performance of contact center capabilities across regions.
- Translate Voice of Customer insights, analytics, and operational needs into prioritized product investments.
- Align contact center product initiatives to end-to-end customer journey improvements.

Agile Product Operating Model (Pods / Squads)
- Establish and lead dedicated cross-functional product pods focused on the highest-impact contact center and CX capabilities.
- Implement a scalable agile pod/squad model enabling: - Faster iteration and delivery
- Continuous feedback loops and improvement
- Strong alignment between CX strategy and product outcomes

- Ensure pods have clear accountability to supported business functions.
- Standardize product management practices, governance, and delivery frameworks globally.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery Orchestration
- Lead and coordinate the work of cross-functional pod teams, including: - Product Managers
- Service / CX Designers (CX/UX)
- Engineering leads and teams
- QA leads and testing teams
- Architects (shared)
- Product Analysts
- Project / Delivery Managers

- Drive alignment from insight, design, build, deploy and optimize.
- Remove silos and ensure end-to-end ownership and accountability across delivery teams.

Product Delivery & Lifecycle Management
- Lead a global portfolio of contact center and CX technology initiatives.
- Own the full product lifecycle: - Discovery and ideation
- Roadmap and prioritization
- Development and release
- Continuous improvement

- Ensure delivery is aligned to measurable business outcomes

Contact Center Technology Ownership (Global Scope)
- Own and drive strategy and execution across key platforms, including: - CRM systems
- Customer Data Platform (CDP)
- Knowledge Base / Knowledge Management
- Agent Workspace / Desktop Experience
- Amazon Connect
- Communication Services (voice, chat, messaging, omnichannel)
- Mainframe customer systems and legacy integrations

- Ensure these platforms are integrated, modernized, and optimized to deliver seamless global customer and agent experiences.

AI & Intelligent Automation
- Drive adoption of AI-driven capabilities, including: - Conversational AI and virtual agents
- Intelligent routing and automation
- Agent assist and real-time support
- Predictive insights and personalization

- Partner with Data & Analytics to embed advanced decisioning into product capabilities.
- Continuously evaluate and scale emerging technologies.

- Proven experience in contact center technologies and customer experience platforms
- Experience leading global, cross-functional teams and transformation initiatives
- Strong background in Agile product management and pod/squad operating models
- Experience with CRM, CDP, contact center platforms (e.g., Amazon Connect), and digital CX ecosystems
- Deep experience leading and implementing AI-driven solutions within contact center environments, including conversational AI, intelligent routing, agent assist, and automation at scale
